title: One call of the gatekit program (<home>/state/calls/journal.jsonl)
description: Appended by the program as it ends, unless GATEKIT_CALLS is 0; read by `gatekit calls`. The command's words only, never the values of its arguments or options.

command.description: The command's words (`registry show`); empty for the program alone (`--help`).

ms.description: From the process's start to its end.

start_ms.description: From the process's start until the command began: the runtime, loading, finding the commands.

from.description: Where the program ran from: the launcher's publish (artifacts/), a build in bin, or elsewhere (an installed GateKit).
